title: Separation from False Teaching and Practices
description: A lesson on living separately from false teachings, sinful practices, and worldly influences.

cards.heading: Called to Be Separate
cards.scriptureText: But you are a chosen people, a royal priesthood...
cards.body: Believers are called out from darkness into God’s marvelous light. This means living separated from worldly influences and dedicated to God.
cards.question: What does it mean for you to live separated unto God?

cards.heading: Citizens of Heaven
cards.scriptureText: But our citizenship is in heaven.
cards.body: Christians are pilgrims in this world. Our identity and loyalty belong first to God’s kingdom, not to worldly philosophies and values.
cards.question: In what ways do worldly values challenge your faith?

cards.heading: A Different Way of Living
cards.scriptureText: Whatever you do, do it all for the glory of God.
cards.body: Believers are called to live Christ-centered lives, where every action is measured by whether it glorifies God.
cards.question: What decisions in your daily life need to be more Christ-centered?

cards.heading: Separation from False Teachings
cards.scriptureText: Do not be yoked together with unbelievers.
cards.body: Christians must avoid false teachings, wrong doctrine, and practices that are not based on Scripture.
cards.question: How do you discern whether a teaching is biblically sound?

cards.heading: Testing Uncertain Things
cards.body: When facing uncertain situations, ask whether it strengthens faith, protects testimony, glorifies God, and keeps the body pure.
cards.question: What current activity in your life needs spiritual evaluation?

cards.heading: The Benefits of Separation
cards.scriptureText: Do not love the world or anything in the world.
cards.body: Living separated unto God brings spiritual stability, answered prayer, God’s favor, and stronger fellowship with true believers.
cards.question: What benefits have you experienced from obeying God in difficult separations?

cards.heading: Why Some Refuse to Separate
cards.scriptureText: By their fruit you will recognize them.
cards.body: Many resist separation because of social pressure, attachment to old habits, fear of rejection, or unwillingness to give up sinful practices.
cards.question: Is there anything in your life that you find difficult to let go of for Christ?
